title: 第十章 老太太的教育第十一章 入住凶宅
content_zh:
第十章【老太太的教育】
上午的时候，陈言下楼在附近找了个面馆吃了碗金陵大碗皮肚面，然后扫了辆共享单车，就出发了。
约好了在在附近的一个房产中介门店，见一个房产经纪。
来之前联络好了，陈言过来的时候，负责接待他的是一个二十岁出头的年轻业务员，身量不高，脸上痘有点多，脑袋上头发有点少。
姓胡，全名胡尚可。
其实还有一个身份：陈言的大学同班同学。
这人在学校的时候就住在陈言隔壁的宿舍，关系不远不近，四年接触下来，人品还不错。
不过四年时间，陈言并没有和这个叫胡尚可的家伙走太近。
属于那种见面了可以勾肩搭背貌似亲热的同学。
但其实没怎么正经交心过。
因为胡尚可这个人虽然人品还成，却有一条让陈言不太看得上这人。
这家伙是个舔狗。
是那种自己节衣缩食，节假日去打临工，也要攒钱请女朋友吃大餐的舔狗。
说一句：陈言是顶瞧不起舔狗这种生物的。
其实，不得不说，陈言在恋爱方面的观念，有点被老太太灌输了些歪七扭八的玩意儿。
当初陈言考上大学去金陵府的之前，老太太跟他说了一番贴心话。
“乖孙啊，你去大学里呢，交女朋友的话，要注意的。
要么你就找那种特别爱钱的，花钱谈。
要么你就找那种特别不在乎钱的，心和钱都可以给。
前者嘛，你随便谈谈就好了，就当花钱买开心。

后者嘛，你遇到了倒是可以带回来给老太婆看看。”
当时呢陈言心里就想着，如今这个世道，后一种女孩么，大概是很难见到了。
这么想的话，其实前一种也挺好，花钱买开心嘛。
问题是……
自己兜里也没钱啊！
除此之外，陈言从小就被老太太教育过，卑躬屈膝讨不来你想要的东西。
老太太曾经领着他去镇子上的烧鸭店门口。
“乖孙啊，你喜欢这家的烧鸭子，如果你没有钱，你去求老板，说尽好话，作揖讨好，你觉得人家会因为你的讨好，就把一只鸭子免费送给你吃不？”
说着，老太太盯着陈言的眼睛，语气很认真：
“不会的！
他明明不想给你鸭子，然后要装装样子给周围的人看，好表现得他不是那么不近人情，就会随便丢两块没人要的鸭脖子和鸭屁股给你，打发打发你。
但你记住了，这种事情不怪人家老板的。
人家的鸭子本来就是拿来卖钱的。
你花不起钱，却想用别人不需要的讨好去换人家拿来卖钱的东西。
人家凭啥给你？
那是你自己没数。”
不得不说，老太太对陈言的教育相当成功。
content_en:
Chapter 10 [Old Lady’s Education]
In the morning, Chen Yan went downstairs and found a nearby noodle shop to eat a bowl of Jinling Big Bowl of Skin Belly Noodles, then bought a shared bicycle and set off.
I made an appointment to meet a real estate agent at a nearby real estate agency store.
We made contact before coming. When Chen Yan came over, the person in charge of receiving him was a young salesman in his early twenties. He was not tall, had a lot of acne on his face, and had a little hair on his head.
The surname is Hu and the full name is Hu Shangke.
In fact, there is another identity: Chen Yan's college classmate.
This man lived in the dormitory next to Chen Yan when he was in school. We were not far or close to each other. After four years of contact, he had a pretty good character.
However, in four years, Chen Yan did not get too close to this guy named Hu Shangke.
He is the kind of classmate who can put their arms around each other and look affectionate when they meet.
But in fact, I never had a serious heart-to-heart talk.
Because although Hu Shangke is a good character, there is one thing that makes Chen Yan not like this person very much.
This guy is a bitch.
He is the kind of licking dog who scrimps on food and clothing, works part-time during holidays, and saves money to treat his girlfriend to a big meal.
One thing to say: Chen Yan looks down upon creatures like licking dogs.
In fact, I have to say that Chen Yan's views on love were a bit crooked and indoctrinated by the old lady.
Before Chen Yan was admitted to college and went to Jinling Mansion, the old lady said some thoughtful words to him.
"My dear grandson, you are going to college. If you want to have a girlfriend, you should be careful.
Or you can find someone who loves money very much and spend money to talk.
Or find someone who doesn't care about money and can give both heart and money.
As for the former, you can just talk casually and treat it as spending money to buy happiness.
Well, if you encounter the latter, you can bring it back to the old woman to see. "
At that time, Chen Yan was thinking that in today's world, the latter kind of girl is probably very difficult to see.
If you think about it this way, the former one is actually quite good, just spend money to buy it and be happy.
The problem is...
I don’t even have any money in my pocket!
In addition, Chen Yan was taught by an old lady since he was a child that you can't get what you want by kneeling down.
The old lady once led him to the door of the roast duck shop in the town.
"My dear grandson, you like the roasted duck here. If you don't have money, go and beg the boss, say all the nice things and bow to please him. Do you think they will give you a duck for free just because you please?"
As she spoke, the old lady stared into Chen Yan's eyes and spoke in a serious tone:
"No!
He obviously doesn't want to give you a duck, but he wants to show off to the people around him so that he can show that he is not so unkind. He will just throw two pieces of duck neck and duck butt that no one wants to you and send you away.
But remember, the boss is not to blame for this kind of thing.
People's ducks are originally sold for money.
You can't afford to spend money, but you want to exchange the unwanted favors of others for things that others sell for money.
Why should they give it to you?
That's because you didn't count. "
It must be said that the old lady's education to Chen Yan was quite successful.
